correctness.rationale: Use the stationary bounded convolution |Y|≤1 in dimensionless time, P=Y·n and Q=|Y|². The first-harmonic semigroup and orientation autonomy give E[P_τ|Y₀,n₀]=M+e^(−(1+α)τ)(P₀−M): in the convolution each n_s·n_τ has conditional mean e^(−α(τ−s)). Since Q'=−2Q+2P and stationarity gives E(QP)=E(Q²) from the time derivative of Q², the two covariance initial conditions both equal V. Solving C'+2C=2V e^(−(1+α)τ) gives H_α, including the resonance (1+2τ)e^(−2τ); its curvature at zero is −2(1+α). For amplitude, the angular action on P² at fixed Y is −θ(P²−Q/3); the position drift supplies −2P²+2P. The drift and the dipolar action on QP give −(3+α)QP+Q+2P². Their stationary balances yield M=(1+α)^−1, E P²=(2+θ/3)M/(2+θ), and E Q²=(M+2E P²)/(3+α). Subtracting M² gives the stated V and differentiating gives the strict negative θ derivative. Solving S=(18+5θ)/(2+θ) gives exactly the stated inverse for 5<S<9. Substituting θ=α and θ=3α gives the ratio, positive gap and limits; in particular V_RTP=5/72 and V_ABP=1/40 at α=1, while the common lag-0.96 kernel is 0.4280923294. These are conclusions about stationary radial squared displacement, not the full position process.
residual_risks: Normalization is only asserted with V>0. The stationary, isotropic, ergodic Markov orientation has the stipulated eigenrelations, and arbitrary positive pairs are not asserted realizable.
The inverse for α assumes calibrated trap time; neither formula asserts a stable finite-sample estimation procedure.

The ABP kernel also follows from previously published arbitrary-initial second moments and stationarity, and separate stationary fourth moments are known. value.rationale: Radial energy is a natural directly defined observable in an isotropic harmonic trap. The result pinpoints which angular information its normalized curve necessarily loses, and identifies a calibrated fourth moment that recovers it when two eigenrates are present. Equal measured all-lag shape can coexist with parametrically different variances, with an exact quantified gap under matched orientation persistence. This supports model discrimination and inverse interpretation beyond computing a familiar moment in a single propulsion model.
residual_risks: This is identifiability from exact stationary observables at known trap rate, not a robustness or estimation result, nor a conclusion with translational thermal noise.
